definitions.explanation: A four-character idiom describing someone who has no sense of shame, who acts boldly despite doing things that should cause embarrassment.

examples.japanese: {厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{呆|あき}れた→呆れる：06720_akireru⟧。
examples.english: I was amazed by such shameless behavior.

examples.japanese: {厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{平気|へいき}→平気：00095_heiki⟧で⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つく→つく：noentry⟧。
examples.english: He shamelessly tells lies without a care.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧)

LITERAL MEANING: ⟦{厚顔|こうがん}→厚顔：09162_kougan⟧ (thick face/skin) + ⟦{無恥|むち}→無恥：16915_muchi⟧ (no shame) = Having a thick skin and no shame.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}な＋noun (shameless ~)
- {厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (shamelessly)
- {厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a shameless person)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (shameless attitude)
- {厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}な⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧ (brazen act)
- {厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{平気|へいき}→平気：00095_heiki⟧で (shamelessly and without hesitation)

NUANCE: Strongly negative, used to criticize someone who should feel ashamed but doesn't.

ENGLISH EQUIVALENTS:
- Shameless
- Brazen
- Thick-skinned
- Having no shame

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{図々|ずうずう}しい→図々しい：06535_zuuzuushii⟧ - shameless, brazen (colloquial)
- ⟦{恥知|はじし}らず→恥知らず：21065_hajishirazu⟧ - shameless person
- ⟦{厚|あつ}かましい→厚かましい：09161_atsukamashii⟧ - impudent, shameless
- ⟦{傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}→傍若無人：06391_boujakubujin⟧ - arrogant, acting as if no one exists
